facts.summary: Input steps: keys list mapped to bytes (Enter=CR, C-c=0x03, etc.); write all keys at once; until marker or EOF; timeout 4s; keep marker and burst.

facts.summary: Output chunks include initial PROMPT> and per-step reads with echo/control/shell prompt; normalize CRLF/CR; closed on EOF; cleanup process group/PTY.
